t_advice_summary_textbox.text: `Gnomes appear in the same pairs, orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, blue and purple. they change position but always in these pairs. there is a dark and a light forest. one gnome always leads to dark and the other to the light forest. the dark forest has a yellow basket and the light one has a red basket. its important to work out which forest has more mushrooms and which colour gnome from each pair leads me there

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes in this game only come in set pairs - yellow & red, blue & purple, orange and brown, and pink & green. They may change which side of the screen they are on, but nothing else. Each gnome in a pair will lead you to either a dark forest with a yellow basket, or a light forest with a red basket - the colour gnome that leads to each forest never changes. One forest will have more mushrooms than the other although this constantly changes, so it is important to try to pick up on any patterns you can in terms of which forest is producing more mushrooms and therefore which colour gnome to click on - remember though that the amount of mushrooms produced changes.
